chose: idle stop keeps hasBackgroundWork with its 30/60 minute limits; measure in PostHog how often a stop goes out while background work expired unfinished
over: a never-expiring busy rule, or counting child processes
because: the limits exist because shells and monitors never send a finish hook (bf1f17379), so no expiry would keep a VM awake for any forgotten dev server; suspend freezes rather than kills a job past its limit; operator wants data before changing it
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
